abort.already_configured: This bwa Wi-Fi Module is already configured

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to this bwa Wi-Fi Module, please try again

error.invalid_rgb: Invalid RGB value. Use the format R,G,B with each value between 0 and 255 (e.g. 255,0,0)

data.sync_time: Keep your Balboa BP controller's time synchronized with Home Assistant
data.keepalive_enabled: Enable keep-alive (usually not needed, the spa already pushes status updates on its own)
data.keepalive_frame_type: Keep-alive frame type: "existing_client_request" (default, gets a real reply from the WiFi module) or "minimal" (silent frame, no reply)
data.reconnect_backoff_mode: Reconnect backoff mode: "exponential" (5s up to 300s) or "fixed" (constant delay)
data.reconnect_fixed_delay: Fixed reconnect delay (seconds, only used when the mode above is "fixed")

data_description.led_delay_on: How long the light stays on during a color cycle pulse
data_description.led_delay_off: How long the light stays off during a color cycle pulse
data_description.led_delay_reset: How long to wait before the color cycle resets back to the first color

data.name: Color name
data.cycles: Number of on/off cycles to reach this color
data.rgb: RGB value (for display only, format: R,G,B)
